notes: A clear checkout for CricSynthesis Pro: your plan, what's due today, when the first charge is, then secure payment
The payment window shows the CricSynthesis logo
CricSynthesis Pro: subscribe in the app (₹349 a month or ₹3,769 a year), with one day free for new accounts
Every match's Overview stays free; the other match-centre sections and MatchSynth Lab are part of Pro
Account shows your plan, your free day or renewal date, and lets you cancel
Cleaner match centre: no Pro labels on the sections
Privacy policy prompt on first launch; anonymous usage analytics (no ads, no advertising ID) start only after you accept, and can be switched off in Settings → Privacy
Every match's Overview stays free; the other match-centre sections are now part of Pro, like MatchSynth Lab (free with any account during the beta)
Accounts are for ages 18 and over: after you sign in, the app asks for your date of birth once (only a note that you're 18+ is kept)
Updated terms and privacy policy
Finished matches open their result in the app: every pre-match projection checked against the scorecard, plus how our fantasy picks scored
Past results in the menu opens the Finished matches list
Players to watch on the Match Overview fills its row, with no gaps
A new Match Overview: projected scores, a runs-per-over chart with expected wickets, when wickets fall, players to watch, the ground and fantasy picks on one screen
Every chart now has clear axes
Live matches that run past midnight stay in the Live list
The bottom bar is now a floating rounded strip
Match screen tags all the same height
Clearer Pro badge on Open in MatchSynth Lab in dark mode
Shorter update alerts, sent once the new version is ready to install
Matching corners everywhere: tags, buttons, cards and charts follow one style
Captain and vice-captain badges look alike in the fantasy team
A fresh Material look for match cards, menus and the bottom bar
Three tabs: Matches, Fantasy and MatchSynth Lab, with a new Lab icon
Match cards: countdown between the teams, full ground names, cleaner layout
Open in MatchSynth Lab right from the top of each match
Alerts when a new version of the app is out; Match alerts now in the menu
New bottom tabs: Matches, Fantasy, Lab and Alerts
Fantasy tab: every upcoming and live match, straight to its fantasy picks
Alerts tab: choose which match alerts you get
"Lineup Out" tag once the playing XIs are named
Matches open on Live or Upcoming; the side menu no longer hides behind the tabs
Tabs along the bottom: Matches, Results, Lab and Account
Swipe left or right to move between a match's tabs
An "XIs in" tag on every match, which updates by itself when the teams are named
New alerts: a match starting soon, today's matches, results, and the captain in the XIs alert
Cleaner screens with less text
The menu opens from your profile icon, in place of the three lines
Match screens no longer have a share button at the top
The update prompt waits until the app has opened and lists what's new
Plainer headings across the match screens
Tabs renamed: Venue, and Batter v bowler
The app tells you when a new version is out
Version number in the side menu and settings
Share the app opens Android's share sheet
Match alerts work on Android 13 and later, and show while the app is open
